name: Region-growing Iso-surface Extraction
definition: A region-growing based iso-surface extraction algorithm that generates high-quality curvature-adaptive semi-regular meshes, preserves sharp features, and extracts all disjoint components of the iso-surface.
summary: Region-growing Iso-surface Extraction generates high-quality, curvature-adaptive meshes by using a normal consistency constraint to ensure robustness for complex topologies and preserve sharp features.
